parts:
I recommend you start by looking in log files (/var/log/shiny-server/*.log, note that this is not the same as /var/log/shiny-server.log) for clues.

On Sun, Mar 12, 2017 at 3:10 PM Ahmad MM <amo...@gmail.com> wrote:


On Sunday, March 12, 2017 at 6:08:48 PM UTC-4, Ahmad MM wrote:
Hi Guys,

linked to my github rep is here: https://github.com/AhmadMobin/SaskKids_RoundA.git

My app works fine on my local PC but when I deploy it almost instantaneously gets disconnected from the shiny server.  

My gut feeling that my csv files have special characters such as °C and that is where my issue is. 

Anyways I know my code is messy. This is my first try. Please any help with be greatly appreciated. 

Thanks
